title: Triptans in the acute management of migraine
text: Triptans act as agonists at serotonin 5-HT1B and 5-HT1D receptors, causing cranial vasoconstriction and inhibition of trigeminal nociceptive neurotransmission. They are most effective when administered early in a migraine attack and are contraindicated in patients with a history of ischemic cardiovascular disease.
